en: Control your Macs from any network with Tailscale: AnyRemote can join your tailnet by itself, without the Tailscale app, and still uses the local network whenever it answers.
An Info sheet for each paired Mac (⌘I) shows how it's connected and lets you rename it, set its address and route, or forget it.
zh-Hans: 借助 Tailscale，在任何网络下都能控制你的 Mac：AnyRemote 可以自己加入你的 tailnet，不需要 Tailscale App；局域网能通时仍然走局域网。
每台已配对的 Mac 都有“信息”面板（⌘I），可以查看它的连接方式，修改名称、地址和路线，或忘记这台 Mac。
